name: HARV-02 live PostgreSQL permissions, conservation, retry and rollback

tests.name: Authenticate disposable fixture administrator
Register planet owner
Register visitor and corporation manager
Create player-owned harvest planet

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(planet_id,sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,type,created_by,population,colonists_unassigned) SELECT 977711,1,'HARV2 Owner QA',player_id,'player','M',1,107,0,0 FROM players WHERE name='harv2_owner_qa' ON CONFLICT(planet_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id,owner_type='player',population=0,population_type='UNPOPULATED';

tests.name: Land owner and visitor on isolated player planet

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=1,lastplanet=977711 WHERE name IN ('harv2_owner_qa','harv2_visitor_qa');

tests.name: Confirm both player ships are landed with sufficient holds

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=1,ported=0,onplanet=TRUE,holds=20,ore=0,organics=0,equipment=0 WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name IN ('harv2_owner_qa','harv2_visitor_qa'));

tests.name: Configure owner planet ORE stock and capacity

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_goods(planet_id,commodity,quantity,max_capacity,production_rate) VALUES(977711,'ORE',2,100,0) ON CONFLICT(planet_id,commodity) DO UPDATE SET max_capacity=100;

tests.name: Seed owner planet accumulated ORE

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) VALUES('planet',977711,'ORE',2,0) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=2;

tests.name: Configure zero ORG and EQU rows required by the all-commodity harvest pass

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_goods(planet_id,commodity,quantity,max_capacity,production_rate) VALUES(977711,'ORG',0,100,0),(977711,'EQU',0,100,0) ON CONFLICT(planet_id,commodity) DO UPDATE SET quantity=0,max_capacity=100;

tests.name: Planet owner can harvest controlled stock
Owner harvest persists stock and cargo atomically

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT quantity=0 FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=977711 AND commodity_code='ORE') AND (SELECT ore=2 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='harv2_owner_qa')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Repeat harvest returns no stock and does not duplicate cargo
Set visitor onto player-owned planet for negative permission test

data.sql: UPDATE players SET lastplanet=977711 WHERE name='harv2_visitor_qa';

tests.name: Landed non-owner cannot harvest
Denied harvest leaves planetary and visitor cargo unchanged

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT quantity=0 FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=977711 AND commodity_code='ORE') AND (SELECT ore=0 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='harv2_visitor_qa')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Create corporation and authorized membership roles

data.sql: INSERT INTO corporations(corporation_id,name,owner_id,tag) SELECT 97771,'HARV2 QA Corporation',player_id,'H2Q' FROM players WHERE name='harv2_owner_qa' ON CONFLICT(corporation_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id;

tests.name: Add visitor as corporation Officer; creation already assigns owner as Leader

data.sql: INSERT INTO corp_members(corporation_id,player_id,role) SELECT 97771,player_id,'Officer' FROM players WHERE name='harv2_visitor_qa' ON CONFLICT(corporation_id,player_id) DO UPDATE SET role=EXCLUDED.role;

tests.name: Create corporation-owned harvest planet

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(planet_id,sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,type,created_by,population,colonists_unassigned) VALUES(977712,1,'HARV2 Corp QA',97771,'corp','M',1,107,0,0) ON CONFLICT(planet_id) DO UPDATE SET owner_id=97771,owner_type='corp',population=0,population_type='UNPOPULATED';

tests.name: Set authorized officer as landed on corporate planet

data.sql: UPDATE players SET lastplanet=977712 WHERE name='harv2_visitor_qa';

tests.name: Create corporate ORE capacity and stock

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_goods(planet_id,commodity,quantity,max_capacity,production_rate) VALUES(977712,'ORE',2,100,0) ON CONFLICT(planet_id,commodity) DO UPDATE SET max_capacity=100;

tests.name: Seed corporate planet ORE stock

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) VALUES('planet',977712,'ORE',2,0) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=2;

tests.name: Configure zero ORG and EQU rows on corporate planet

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_goods(planet_id,commodity,quantity,max_capacity,production_rate) VALUES(977712,'ORG',0,100,0),(977712,'EQU',0,100,0) ON CONFLICT(planet_id,commodity) DO UPDATE SET quantity=0,max_capacity=100;

tests.name: Authorized corporation Officer can harvest
Downgrade visitor to ordinary corporation Member

data.sql: UPDATE corp_members SET role='Member' WHERE corporation_id=97771 AND player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='harv2_visitor_qa');

tests.name: Restore one ORE unit to corporate planet for denial check

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) VALUES('planet',977712,'ORE',1,0) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=1;

tests.name: Ordinary corporation Member cannot withdraw by harvesting
Member refusal preserves corporate stock and previous cargo

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT quantity=1 FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=977712 AND commodity_code='ORE') AND (SELECT ore=2 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='harv2_visitor_qa')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Install controlled cargo failure function

data.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_harv2_fail_cargo() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='harv2_owner_qa') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled HARV-02 rollback'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$;

tests.name: Install cargo trigger for owner harvest rollback

data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER v3_harv2_fail_cargo BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON ship_cargo FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION v3_harv2_fail_cargo();

tests.name: Restore one ORE unit before injected rollback

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) VALUES('planet',977711,'ORE',1,0) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=1;

tests.name: Injected cargo write failure refuses owner harvest
Injected failure rolls planetary stock and ship cargo back

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT quantity=1 FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=977711 AND commodity_code='ORE') AND (SELECT ore=2 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='harv2_owner_qa')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Drop HARV-02 fault trigger

data.sql: DROP TRIGGER v3_harv2_fail_cargo ON ship_cargo;

tests.name: Drop HARV-02 fault function

data.sql: DROP FUNCTION v3_harv2_fail_cargo();
